RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, July 27, 2015/Sravana 5, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Drinking Water and Sanitation; Human Resource
Development; New and Renewable Energy; Panchayati Raj; Power;
Road Transport and Highways; Rural Development; Shipping;
Water Resources, River Development and
Ganga Rejuvenation)
Total number of questions — 15
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Coastal shipping trade between
neighbouring countries
*61. SHRI PANKAJ BORA: Will the
Minister of  SHIPPING be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has approved
bilateral coastal shipping trade between
neighbouring countries; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Promotion of vocational courses in
secondary schools
*62. SHRIMATI RAJANI PATIL: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has drawn any
policy for promotion of vocational courses
in secondary schools to tackle problem of
unemployment and if so, the details
thereof;
(b) the budgetary allocations during the
current Five Year Plan for vocational
education in schools in the country;
(c) the total sanctioned and filled-in
strength of vocational education teachers
in different categories; and
(d) what is the status of the overall
vocational education scenario in Rajasthan
and how it compares with other States?
Irregularities under PMGSY
†*63. SHRI RAMDAS ATHAWALE:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of any
irregularities committed under the Pradhan
Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY)
during the last three years and if so, the
details thereof; and
(b) whether Government has conducted
any inquiry in this regard and if so, the
details and the outcome thereof?

22
Restrictions on minority education
†*64. SHRIMATI KANAK LATA
SINGH: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the cases of
putting restrictions on the education being
imparted in the minority educational
institutions under the Right of children to
Free and Compulsory Education (RTE) Act
have come to the notice and if so, the details
thereof; and
(b) whether the impediments being
created to the minority education are not a
violation of fundamental rights keeping in
view the provisions of Article 30(1) of the
Constitution which provides right to the
religious and linguistic minorities to
establish and administer educational
institutions of their choice and if so, the
details thereof?
Ganga rejuvenation project
*65. SHRI D. KUPENDRA  REDDY:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES, RIVER DEVELOPMENT
AND GANGA REJUVENATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether river Ganga rejuvenation
project has started functioning;
(b) if so, the date from which the project
has started functioning;
(c) the details of works done from the
date of starting the project, till date; and
(d) the amount earmarked for the project
and the amount spent, so far?
Meeting of National Monitoring
Committee on Land Acquisition
Issues
*66. SHRI PALV AI GOV ARDHAN
REDDY: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the National Monitoring
Committee on Land Acquisition Issues had
a meeting on April 25, 2015;
(b) the details of subjects that were
discussed;
(c) whether any time-frame was set up
to obtain early outcomes for relief to
displaced people in various areas; and
(d) if so, the steps taken/proposed to
be taken to extend the benefits of the new
Land Acquisition Act of 2013 to tribals
and farmers?
Measures to mitigate risks in land
acquisition
*67. SHRI D. BANDYOPADHYAY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of the
eight risks suffered by the oustees of
involuntary displacement through land
acquisition including landlessness,
joblessness, homelessness, food insecurity,
etc. and that women as food providers to
family actually suffer more than men; and
(b) if so, whether Government is
contemplating any special set of measures
to mitigate these gender-biased risks in the
proposed Land Acquisition Bill?
National Highways in Kalaburagi
(Gulbarga) district, Karnataka
*68. SHRI BASAWARAJ PATIL: Will
the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

23
(a) what are the National Highway
works proposed in Kalaburagi (Gulbarga)
district in Karnataka; and
(b) what is the cost, when the work
would commence and when the work would
be completed, keeping in view that
Kalaburagi (Gulbarga) is a fast growing city?
Energy financing challenges
*69. SHRI MOHD. ALI KHAN: Will
the Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is working on
energy financing challenges for future; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Construction of roads under PMGSY

JATIYA: Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be please

————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, July 27, 2015/Sravana 5, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Drinking Water and Sanitation; Human Resource
Development; New and Renewable Energy; Panchayati Raj; Power;
Road Transport and Highways; Rural Development; Shipping;
Water Resources, River Development and Ganga Rejuvenation)
Total number of questions — 160
Proposal for allocation of mines
641. SHRI PAUL MANOJ
PANDIAN: Will the Minister of COAL
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is considering a proposal for allocation of
mines to State Governments for making
the fuel available to the small scale
industries and the household sectors;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that a Model
Contract Agreement had also been drafted
to enable the State Governments to
undertake this activity; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Exploitation of coal reserves
642. SHRI HUSAIN DALW AI: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) the estimates of coal reserves in India,
State-wise;
(b) how much of this is being exploited,
State-wise;
(c) the grade-wise distribution of the
exploited coal; and
(d) the steps taken to increase coal
production and to reduce coal imports?
Abandoned CIL projects to private
players
643. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) how many projects have been
abandoned/discontinued by the Coal India
Limited during the last one year;
(b) the names and the details thereof
and the reasons therefor;
(c) the estimated loss to CIL as a result
thereof;
(d) whether there is any proposal to
award the abandoned CIL projects to
private players; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

151
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Status of Underground Coal
Gasification technology
644. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of Underground
Coal Gasification (UGC) Technology
developed in the country for meeting the
future energy needs;
(b) the details of coal and lignite blocks
identified, so far, for this purpose; and
(c) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
by Government to popularize this
technology in the country?
Illegal sale and availability of coal in
open market
645. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD:
SHRI D.P. TRIPATHI:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it has come to the notice of
Government that there is illegal selling/
availability of coal in the open market in
Jharkhand and Meghalaya;
(b) if so, the details of such cases; and
(c) the action taken against such illegal
practices and for active monitoring of coal
fields there?
Revenue received from coal auction
646. SHRI RAJEEV
CHANDRASEKHAR: Will the Minister
of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) what is the total revenue received
by Government from the recently
concluded coal auction;
(b) the details of expected annual
revenue earned on account of such auctions
during the next 30 years; and
(c) the details of annual revenue that
the individual States would receive during
the next 30 years, State-wise?
Coal reserves
647. SHRI AHMED PATEL: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) the details of coal mines/blocks along
with the quantity of coal reserves in the
country, State/UT-wise;
(b) the quantity of the coal extracted by
the mining companies during each of the
last three years and during the current year,
company-wise;
(c) the details of coal imported during
the said period, country-wise; and
(d) the details of coal mines/blocks
acquired abroad by the Indian companies
and amount of coal imported and extracted
from these mines in each of the last three
years and the current year, company-wise?
Allocations under commercial mining
†648. DR. BHUSHAN LAL JANGDE:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government would provide
the amount of additional levy of coal to
Chhattisgarh and by when this amount
would be provided;
(b) whether the Chhattisgarh Mineral
Development Corporation has
recommended the allocations under
commercial mining of five coal blocks; and
(c) whether Government would extend
its co-operation considering the fact that
coal is supplied to small and medium
industries like power plants, sponge iron,

152
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
cement plants, etc. from those five coal
blocks as mentioned in part (b)?
Coal deposits
649. SHRI S. THANGAVELU: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in India,
majority of coal deposits are found in the
three eastern States of Jharkhand, Odisha
and West Bengal;
(b) whether it is also a fact that West
Bengal-Ranigunj coal belt contains some of
the prized coals of the country;
(c) whether apart from the above,
substantial coal deposits are found in
Chhattisgarh, Maharashtra and Uttar
Pradesh; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Coal for power generation
